records.title: A comprehensive review of recent advancements in hyperspectral object tracking
records.abstractSummary: Systematic review covers hyperspectral video acquisition, calibration/correction, band selection, Siamese/Transformer/multimodal tracking, public datasets, metrics and future directions.

records.title: Sparse Tensor Attention for Hyperspectral Unmixing
records.abstractSummary: STU uses self-supervised sparse tensor attention linked to Tucker decomposition; sparse tensorized attention and mode-wise low-rank factors model nonlocal spatial-spectral structure, with nonnegative and sum-to-one abundance constraints.
